description: This file contains a class for configuring and transforming rerank requests and responses between Cohere's format and Vertex AI Discovery Engine's format, including URL construction, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

classes.name: VertexAIRerankConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI Discovery Engine Rerank API, including URL generation, environment validation, request transformation, and response parsing.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the Vertex AI ranking API, using project ID from parameters or environment.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Prepares authentication headers for Vertex AI API, obtaining access tokens and project info.

methods.name: transform_rerank_request
methods.description: Converts a Cohere-style rerank request into Vertex AI Discovery Engine's expected format.

methods.name: transform_rerank_response
methods.description: Parses Vertex AI's response and converts it into Cohere's rerank response format.

methods.name: get_supported_cohere_rerank_params
methods.description: Returns list of supported parameters for Cohere rerank requests.

methods.name: map_cohere_rerank_params
methods.description: Maps Cohere rerank parameters into Vertex AI request format.
